difficulty_reason: The lemma states the property P(f) = 'f is perfect' is fpqc local on the base. The retained proof is written against the standard descending-properties criterion (Descent, lemma descending-properties-morphisms): perfect morphisms are Zariski local on the base by the chapter's Definition (definition-perfect), preserved under flat base change by the chapter's lemma-flat-base-change-perfect, and the remaining descent hypothesis is translated by the author into an explicit algebra statement: for a faithfully flat A -> B and a finite type A-algebra C = A[x_1,...,x_n]/I, if C tensor_A B is a perfect complex as a module over B[x_1,...,x_n] then C is perfect over A[x_1,...,x_n], which is exactly the cited More on Algebra lemma (more-algebra-lemma-flat-descent-perfect). Retained author proof at lines 17881-17898.
